title: Besicovitch covering lemma (Simon 3.12; proof from Evans–Gariepy)
statement: For each n there is N = N(n) such that for every set B of pairs (centre in ℝⁿ, radius > 0) with radii bounded above, there are N subfamilies D_1, …, D_N ⊆ B, each consisting of pairwise disjoint closed balls, whose balls cover the set of centres of B.
